mapper.sql: log_id, business_type, business_id, title, content, receiver_ids, receiver_names, channel, send_status, send_time, retry_count, error_message, create_time, update_time, deleted
mapper.select: SELECT FROM notification_logs WHERE business_type = #{businessType} AND business_id = #{businessId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT FROM notification_logs WHERE send_status = 'failed' AND deleted = 0 AND retry_count < #{maxRetryCount} ORDER BY create_time ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE notification_logs SET send_status = #{sendStatus}, send_time = #{sendTime}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE log_id = #{logId} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE notification_logs SET retry_count = retry_count + 1, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE log_id = #{logId} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN send_status = 'success' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS success, SUM(CASE WHEN send_status = 'failed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failed, SUM(CASE WHEN send_status = 'pending' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pending, SUM(CASE WHEN send_status = 'sending' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sending FROM notification_logs WHERE deleted = 0
